title: Finiteness of null subvarieties and optimal destabilizers for the J-equation
summary: Let $X$ be a compact Kähler manifold and $(α,β)$ be a pair of Kähler classes. We show that when $(α,β)$ is $J$-semistable, the collection of positive-dimensional irreducible $J$-null subvarieties is finite. We also obtain a uniform positive lower bound for the normalized $J$-slope of every irreducible non-$J$-null subvariety. This confirms the finiteness and uniform-gap expectation of Khalid-Sjöström Dyrefelt \cite[Section 1.2, Theorem 1.5; Remark 1.8]{KSD26}. As a corollary, we show that the collection of optimal destabilizers is finite when the stability threshold is nonpositive.
